channel.title: The Minnesota Star Tribune - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Minnesota Star Tribune (startribune.com)

item.title: Life Time founder tops public CEO pay in Minnesota, earning $218M in 2025
item.description: Options granted in prior years drove the compensation package.

item.title: Metro Transit’s new police chief says changing perception of crime is biggest challenge
item.description: “I know this organization inside and out. I know transit policing inside and out,” he said.

item.title: Final results from girls basketball state tournament: Two title matchups set
item.description: Hopkins and Rosemount will meet Saturday for the 4A crown, while Stewartville will play Benilde-St. Margaret’s in 3A.

item.title: Much of Minnesota under high wind warning ahead of weekend snowstorm
item.description: Secure loose items and keep your hands on the wheel as winds will gust to up to 65 mph, the National Weather Service said.

item.title: St. Paul police investigating allegation that Macalester professor urinated on student’s backpack
item.description: Police said they are weighing whether to pursue charges.

item.title: Champlin City Council member resigns following felony tax evasion charges
item.description: The city announced Tim LaCroix’s resignation, saying that it was a personal matter for the council member.

item.title: Fast-tracked asylum hearings for Somali refugees being held in secret
item.description: The Fort Snelling Immigration Court sped up the hearing process for Somali nationals in Minnesota days after the Trump administration announced it was ending protections from deportation.

item.title: Trump removes sanctions on Russia to help oil flow amid Iran conflict
item.description: Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent said it was “unfortunate” that the move could benefit Russia, but maintained that it was only for the short term.

item.title: UCare meltdown leads to long hold times, medical transportation problems for patients
item.description: Minnetonka-based Medica, which took over operations Jan. 1, says it has addressed long call center waits and delays with scheduling patient transportation.

item.title: The latest: Vikings sign Kyler Murray, setting up QB competition with J.J. McCarthy
item.description: The Vikings were considered the leading contender to sign Murray, a former No. 1 pick who was released by Arizona on Wednesday, March 11.
